text:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Detected control-plane heartbeat loss for region us-west-3 (3m). API p95 spikes, controlplane-api is not responding to /health. Auto-escalation enabled.

alex: seeing errors from customers in us-west. can someone confirm telemetry? any traffic shifted yet?

maria: looking now — control-plane k8s API in us-west-3 unresponsive from the control-plane fleet. console shows 503s for /models and /metadata.

sre_tony: starting failover checklist. initiating read-only switch for hosted-api to route -> us-east-1. tagging for customers on dedicated capacity stays local.

jamie: how much spare GPU capacity do we have in us-east-1 for burst? need estimate before we shift traffic.

kieran: quick checks:
```
# rough capacity snapshot
kubectl get nodes -l pool=gpu -o json | jq '.items | length as $n | {nodes:$n, allocatable: [.[]|.status.allocatable] }'
# output: nodes: 48, free_gpus: ~10
```

maria: we have ~10 spare GPUs but many are on preemptible nodes. recommend throttled cutover to avoid OOM.

alex: priority: avoid noisy neighbor OOMs. can we do staged traffic shift with canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%?

sre_tony: yes. setting route policy: canary windows 5m, backoff 2x. adding qps cap per pod.

ops-bot: ACTIONS:
- @sre_tony start canary shift (10%) -> scheduled
- @kieran validate cache warmers in us-east-1
- @maria watch control-plane logs & etcd connectivity

kieran: warming KV cache now. hitting warmup endpoint:
```
curl -X POST https://us-east-1.warmup.redwood/api/warm
# 202 Accepted
```

jamie: note: Dedicated customers with strict geo pins will see errors until private control plane reconnects. ops, do we send an incident banner?

alex: yes, post incident banner on status page + in-app banner for affected customers. prioritize enterprise comms.

maria: control-plane instances show intermittent etcd leader election. looks like network flaps between availability zones. working with cloud provider to confirm.

sre_tony: progress: canary at 10% stable for 6m, latency down to normal for canary traffic. increasing to 50% now.

ops-bot: update: canary -> 50% initiated. monitoring for 10m.

kieran: monitoring GPU queue lengths, no OOMs so far. CPU steady.

jamie: cost note: sustained shift increases cross-region egress; estimate additional ~$8k/day while us-west-3 is degraded. flagging finance.

alex: thanks — keep updates brief and post any rollback triggers. I'll draft status message.

maria: adding logs snippet for provider support:
```
ERROR 2026-05-02T15:12:40Z etcd: network timeout to peer 10.4.2.3:2380
```

sre_tony: if AZ-level networking confirmed, we may scale down control-plane replicas in us-west-3 to avoid split-brain until provider completes routing fix.

ops-bot: next update in 10m or on any state change. reactions: :thumbsup: :rotating_light:
